9 holes · Par 36 · 3,182 yards

PinehavenGolf Club

Walk the course, take the cart, play all nine.

How to play

  1. Walk with W A S D and look around with the mouse (click the course to capture it). Hold Shift to run. On touch screens, use the stick on the left and drag on the right.
  2. Play a shot: walk up to your ball and press E. Aim with A D or the mouse, pick a club with W S, then press Space three times: start, set power, stop on the white line.
  3. Early on the third press hooks the ball left; late slices it right. On the green, misses push or pull the putt.
  4. Drive the cart: press E next to it to hop in, W S to drive, A D to steer, Space to brake, E to get out.
  5. Hole out, then follow the marker to the next tee.
V
First or third person
T
Shot camera: behind, landing area, overhead
Space hold
Fast-forward while the camera follows the ball
M / C
Course map / scorecard
N
Sound on or off
Esc
Cancel a swing, step away, or close a panel

Wind, slope and lie all matter. Rough costs distance, bunkers more (wedges cope best). Water and out of bounds cost a stroke. On the green, arrows show which way it breaks.
